description: On desktop, the app's own page may show the folder picker, reopen or forget a folder the person picked before, and keep trust records in the profile through pick_folder, reopen_folder, forget_folder and the trust_* commands. A grant opens a folder only when the person picked it or said yes to the shell's own question (crates/trust-grant). It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets no trust. Android has no folder picker.
